title: Find the display name of the owner of the most popular post (by view count)
question: Find the display name of the owner of the most popular post (by view count) among all posts that were edited by users who have both cast at least one vote and own at least one post with zero comments.

prediction.sql: SELECT u.XCL_055 FROM posts AS p JOIN users AS u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052 WHERE p.XCL_026 IN (SELECT ph.XCL_014 FROM postHistory AS ph WHERE ph.XCL_017 IN (SELECT u2.XCL_052 FROM users AS u2 WHERE u2.XCL_052 IN (SELECT v.XCL_070 FROM votes AS v) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM posts AS p2 WHERE p2.XCL_033 = u2.XCL_052 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM comments AS c WHERE c.XCL_006 = p2.XCL_026)))) ORDER BY p.XCL_030 DESC LIMIT 1

measures.eligibility_application: posts must be edited by eligible users
measures.multiplicity_argument: one row per post, no duplication

arguments.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
WHERE p.XCL_026 IN (
    SELECT ph.XCL_014
    FROM postHistory ph
    WHERE ph.XCL_017 IN (
        SELECT u2.XCL_052
        FROM users u2
        WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM votes v WHERE v.XCL_070 = u2.XCL_052)
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM posts p2
              WHERE p2.XCL_033 = u2.XCL_052
                AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.XCL_006 = p2.XCL_026)
          )
    )
)
ORDER BY p.XCL_030 DESC
LIMIT 1
